rules.description: EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970 — national transposition status (as verified 2026-10-18)

source.title: EUR-Lex: National transposition measures communicated by the Member States concerning Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: Status as at 2026-10-18 from the EUR-Lex national-transposition-measures list (the Commission records notifications; it does not certify completeness). Spain notified only pre-existing measures (Constitution, ET, LO 3/2007, RD 901/2020 and RD 902/2020 on equality plans and pay equality); no dedicated transposition act found. Pending legal review whether these partially transpose the Directive.

rules.description: Estatuto de los Trabajadores art. 34.9: the employer must guarantee a daily record of working time with the exact start and finish time of each worker; records kept for four years

source.title: Real Decreto Legislativo 2/2015, Estatuto de los Trabajadores, art. 34.9 (BOE consolidated text)

versions.notes: Art. 34.9: "La empresa garantizará el registro diario de jornada, que deberá incluir el horario concreto de inicio y finalización de la jornada de trabajo de cada persona trabajadora"; "La empresa conservará los registros ... durante cuatro años y permanecerán a disposición de las personas trabajadoras, de sus representantes legales y de la Inspección de Trabajo y Seguridad Social." Paragraph 9 was added by art. 10 of Real Decreto-ley 8/2019 (BOE-A-2019-3481, published 12 March 2019), which applies it two months after publication (disposición final sexta.4) — 12 May 2019. Organisation of the record by collective agreement or company decision is not modelled.
